## Integration

| Source contribution | Adaptation |
| --- | --- |
| Evidence-grounded paper review | Shared claim/evidence and finding records; fair strengths, actionable concerns, and uncertainty distinctions. |
| Literature comparison and reference verification | One source record reused for novelty, baselines, bibliography identity, and claim support. |
| Writing and scientific presentation | Claim-preserving edits, consistent numbers/notation, reproducibility and comparison checks. |
| Templates and submission preparation | Current official-rule lookup and final artifact inspection; no bundled old templates. |

Year-specific conference limits, numeric scoring scales, reviewer obligations, and disclosure rules are not copied as current policy. Universal mandates about section names, checklists, page counts, citation quotas, and writing formulas are removed or made conditional. Unsupported statistics about reviewers and model citation errors are omitted. Provider-specific installation, mandatory API dependencies, automatic drafting, and repeated framing approvals are omitted.

New integration guidance covers audit-only defaults, authorized revision mode, deduplicated findings, explicit check coverage, and priority separated from certainty. This adaptation is distributed under the MIT license in LICENSE.
